text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: dedicated-pool azimuth-enterprise - GPU saturation > 95% for 4m, queue depth rising. Impact: tenant-only pool.

sarah: Acknowledged. I'm on it. oncall-ml, can you jump in? Do we have evidence autoscaler failed to provision?

mike: I'm on call-ml. Looking at autoscaler events now. Quick obs: controller logs show "scale denied: max_pool_size" for azimuth-enterprise.

ramon: Hi team — Azimuth account lead here. Customer reports failures on their inference endpoints. They're seeing HTTP 503s. Please prioritize.

elaine: Copy. What is current pool config? Any burst policy enabled?

mike: `redwoodctl pools describe azimuth-enterprise --json`
```
pool: azimuth-enterprise
size: 8 GPUs
max_size: 8
autoscale: enabled
burst_policy: none
queued_requests: 240
gpu_util: 96%
```

sarah: Looks like max_size capped at 8, autoscaler can't increase. We need emergency burst or increase max_size. Ops, any spare capacity in region-eu-west-1?

oncall-ml: Checking cluster capacity and reserved pools. Quick `nodepool free-gpus --region eu-west-1` shows 2 free GPUs, but no immediate dedicated slots without preemption.

mike: Suggest immediate short-term mitigation: enable burst to use shared-hosted capacity (non-dedicated) for this tenant for 10 mins, then revert. Need approval from infra-svc to bypass reserved limits.

sarah: I'll page infra-svc and request one-off burst permit. Meanwhile, start throttling lower-priority jobs for other tenants on the same hostgroup to free 4 GPUs.

ramon: Customer consent: Azimuth authorizes temporary degraded performance but needs endpoints up. They approved burst for 15m.

karen: CS confirmed with Azimuth and provided incident contato point: lisa@azimuth.ai

incident-bot: infra-svc paged: @infra-svc manual-approval required for burst. Ticket #INC-241888 opened.

sarah: infra-svc approved manual burst +4 GPUs for 15m. Executing now: `redwoodctl pools burst --pool azimuth-enterprise --add-gpus 4 --duration 900`

mike: Executed. New pool status:
```
size: 12 GPUs
gpu_util: 82%
queued_requests: 30
```

elaine: Endpoints are green from the metrics dashboard. 200s replacing 503s. Customer pinged: Lisa acknowledges recovery.

ramon: Thanks. Requesting follow-up: update pool max_size to 16 and schedule a config change to avoid repeated manual bursts.

sarah: Agreed. Filing infra config change request and tagging product for cost/SLAs. Will keep this thread for the post-incident notes.

oncall-ml: Handoff: I'll own the incident timeline and initial remediation log for the postmortem. @sarah you're primary SRE lead for follow-up.

karen: Noted. CS will coordinate customer communication and remediation summary.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> customer-facing symptoms reduced. Action items created: INC-241888 (burst), CM-241889 (config change), PM-241890 (postmortem).

sarah: Closing live paging. If queue climbs again, escalate to exec oncall. Good work everyone :thumbsup:
